question: Find the duration (in years) in which ₹1,200 will amount to ₹2,220 at a rate of 20% per annum simple interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,200

Amount (A) = ₹2,220

Rate (R) = 20% per annum

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

SI = (P times R times T)/(100)

Where T = Time in years

**Calculations:**

Simple Interest (SI) = 2220 - 1200

⇒ SI = ₹1,020

Using the formula for Simple Interest:

1020 = (1200 times 20 times T)/(100)

⇒ 1020 = 12 × 20 × T

⇒ 1020 = 240 × T

⇒ T = (1020)/(240)

⇒ T = 4.25 years

**∴ The duration is 4.25 years.**
